policy_name: GOODS RETURN AND CREDIT NOTE POLICY

rules.heading: 1. Scope
rules.statement: Applies to all goods received from suppliers under a current supply agreement.

rules.heading: 2. Window
rules.statement: Returns are raised within the returns window stated in the applicable supply agreement. Where no agreement is in force on the date of receipt, no return may be raised and the matter is escalated to the owner.

rules.heading: 3. Condition
rules.statement: Goods must be in original packaging and, for perishables, within one third of remaining shelf life.

rules.heading: 4. Credit
rules.statement: Credit notes are applied against the next invoice from the same supplier, never refunded in cash.
